olivia: PTAL — addressed comments about host routing and canary settings. pushed fixup (force-pushed) to branch feature/host-routing. Local unit + integration tests green. CI queued: https://ci.redwood/1234

matt: link? can't find the PR.

olivia: https://git.redwood/infra/PR/457 — top commit 'fix: routing nits' (squash ok). also added small fallback for region mismatch.

ci-bot: Build started for PR #457 — checks: unit (running), integration (queued), e2e (queued)

sophie: quick Q: any perf delta on tail latency? last time this routing change spiked p95.

olivia: measured on my dev rig — no regression: p50 22ms, p95 64ms, p99 110ms. added a canary script (see snippet). Also enabled adaptive batching for that route.

olivia: snippet:
```
scripts/canary_run.sh --pr 457 --region us-west1 --duration 10m
```

jordan: LGTM with one nit about log message wording. can you change "host not found" -> "host resolved to fallback" and then merge?

olivia: done, squashed commit with log wording change. CI passed: unit ✅ integration ✅ e2e ✅. Ready for canary.

matt: :thumbsup: I'll kick the canary at 10:30 PT and report back.

sophie: can you add a smoke-check link to the canary dashboard after kick-off? helps me validate.

olivia: will do. I added a dashboard link in the PR comment — will post results here once canary completes.

matt: kicked canary, dashboard: https://dash.redwood/canary/457 — initial traffic ramping. ping @sophie @jordan

sophie: checking metrics now — no obvious errors, latency in line with dev numbers. :ok_hand:

jordan: OK to merge once canary finishes and no regression for 30m. thanks all.

olivia: noted, merging window is EOD Friday; if canary stays healthy I'll merge earlier. PTAL again if you have any other blockers.
